spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पेटयति)
1 To sound.
2 To assemble or heap together.

m. (-टः)
1 A basket for holding grain, a sort of cupboard or granary made of bambus or canes.
2 A basket, a box.
n. (-टं)
A house, a hovel.
E.
पिट to collect, क aff.

mfn. subst. (-कः-का-कं)
A boil.
m. (-कः)
1 A basket, a box.
2 A large basket, or receptacle of basket work, for keeping grain, &c. a granary.
E.
पिट to collect, aff. क्वुन्; also षिट and पेटक.

m. (-कः)
The name of a saint.
E.
पिट to collect, and आक Uṇādi aff.

n. (-कं)
The tartar or excretion of the teeth.
E.
पिट to collect, aff. क्त, and कन् added.

m. (-शः)
A species of pike, (Esox scolopax.)
